title: queen-bee hook runtime: adapter port + D7b conformance rig + trivial hooks (tools-logger, codex-subagent-audit)
action: Add `queen-bee hook NAME` runtime to the bin crate (per D2), --source accepted in both forms (--source=VALUE and --source VALUE; a value outside plugin/repo logs the invalid-source coverage-gap line verbatim per adapter.mjs:349): tolerant stdin JSON read (non-object/parse-error normalizes to {} plus coverage-gap log, matching adapter.mjs readHookContext), root discovery walking .git plus .bee/onboarding.json incl. linked-worktree gitdir pointers and controlRootFor semantics (adapter.mjs resolveRoots), HOOK-ENABLED TOGGLE honored exactly (state.mjs hookEnabled semantics: .bee/config.json hooks map, a disabled hook exits 0 silently before any work — one conformance fixture per hook covers the disabled case), fail-open contract (internal crash gives exit 0 plus .bee/logs/hooks.jsonl crash line {ts,hook,source?,error}; coverage-gap lines {ts,hook,event:"coverage-gap",gap,detail max 300,source?}), output encodings exactly: advisory events (ADVISORY_EVENTS = PreCompact, SubagentStop, Stop) give JSON {systemMessage}, block gives JSON {decision:"block",reason}, context events give plain stdout; event name from payload.hook_event_name. Port the two trivial hooks: tools-logger (append .bee/logs/tools.jsonl {ts,tool_name,agent_id,agent_type,duration_ms,status}, never blocks, no output) and codex-subagent-audit (bounded audit line to hooks.jsonl, fields capped 120/80 chars). Build the D7b CONFORMANCE RIG as ONE integration-test target hook_conformance in crates/queen-bee/tests/ (verify uses cargo --test hook_conformance; missing target exits 101). RIG DISCIPLINE (panel B3 + advisor notes 1/3/4, inherited by every corpus built on this rig): (i) SEEDING — every temp root seeded with a copy of .bee/bin/lib/ AND .bee/bin/hooks/ AND .bee/onboarding.json AND an enabling config.json; the rig asserts each seeded hook/lib file's sha256 equals the repo source (a doctored oracle copy is a rig failure); (ii) NON-TRIVIALITY BOTH WAYS — every deny fixture asserts the node oracle exited 2 before diffing, and every ALLOW fixture is paired with a twin-deny in the SAME root (one field flipped so node must exit 2) OR asserts an explicit engagement signal, so a mis-seeded root can never read as a genuine allow; (iii) negative-control unseeded-root fixture must be DETECTED as invalid rig setup; (iv) rig output lists fixture names per class so cap evidence can quote class coverage, not just a passed count. Per fixture: run the real node hook (file-based driver, absolute path, cwd at temp root) and queen-bee hook NAME, diff exit code, stdout, stderr class, normalized side-effect files. Crash fixtures assert fail-open parity; rig red-first: a deliberately divergent handler must produce a reported diff. Temp roots only; bee-core fsutil for appends.

truths: cargo --test hook_conformance runs (missing target exits 101) and reports at least 10 passed, output listing fixture names per class
queen-bee hook tools-logger and codex-subagent-audit pass conformance vs the real node hooks on all fixtures
fixture classes present: disabled-hook, malformed stdin, invalid-source coverage-gap, advisory-vs-context encoding, crash fail-open, negative-control unseeded root, allow-with-twin-deny pairing
rig asserts seeded oracle files sha256-match the repo source
rig red-first: seeded divergent behavior produces a reported diff and non-zero rig exit

artifacts.substantive: hook runtime module plus hooks (tools-logger, codex-subagent-audit) plus hook_conformance rig with seeded-root fixture corpus, no stubs

key_links: conformance rig executes the real .bee/bin/hooks/*.mjs in node children, sha256-verified verbatim copies
hook appends go through bee-core fsutil
prohibitions: No edits to .bee/bin/ or packages/bee/ (D1 freeze)
No wiring-file edits — flip is a later dedicated slice
No edits to crates/Cargo.toml members list
Tests never touch the repo's live .bee/ store

trace.outcome: Ported the queen-bee hook runtime (adapter.mjs + tools-logger + codex-subagent-audit) to crates/queen-bee, plus the D7b hook_conformance rig (11 table-driven test fns) proving both against the real frozen mjs hooks via seeded, sha256-verified temp roots.
deviations: codex-subagent-audit.mjs (frozen source, read at .bee/bin/hooks/bee-codex-subagent-audit.mjs) never imports state.mjs or calls hookEnabled — it is gated purely by hook_event_name (SubagentStart/SubagentStop vs. unsupported-subagent-event coverage gap). The cell's action text generalizes "HOOK-ENABLED TOGGLE honored exactly" across the hook runtime; ported this hook faithfully to the ACTUAL frozen source instead (matching reality over the cell's shorthand, per the read-first/D1-freeze discipline other bee-core files in this feature already document). The disabled_hook fixture for this hook proves PARITY (both runtimes still log when "disabled") rather than gating; the real allow/deny pairing for this hook is SubagentStart vs. an unsupported event name, covered by a dedicated twin fixture.

Added a `[lib]` target to crates/queen-bee/Cargo.toml (queen-bee shipped bin-only before this cell) so crates/queen-bee/tests/hook_conformance.rs can call the ported adapter functions (is_advisory_event/encode_advisory/encode_block/emit_hook_output) directly for the advisory-vs-context-encoding fixture class, in addition to driving the compiled binary as a subprocess for the stdin/exit-code/side-effect fixtures. Stays entirely inside crates/queen-bee/ (in-scope) and does not touch the frozen crates/Cargo.toml workspace members list.
